evidence.subject: Mathematics
evidence.visualReview: The preserved UPSC PDF identifies NDA & NA Examination II 2026, provisional key, Paper I Mathematics, Series A, 120 questions, zero dropped and 120 scored. Series A was read column-first and row-first; both transcriptions agree.

searchLog.result: Current official answer-key route checked; no later final or revised Mathematics key was recovered during this release pass.
Official document identity and filename preserved from the supplied UPSC PDF; the current site route returned HTML, so the byte-identical local copy is the release evidence.

signoff.reviewerMethod: First full visual comparison against the supplied Series A scan followed by a fresh page-by-page reread; same AI agent, not independent human review.
signoff.classificationMethod: Question-by-question concept pass against the existing NDA Mathematics syllabus, followed by a fresh placement reread by the same AI agent.
